articles.summaryCn: 文章介绍了中国南方电网在AI原生电网范式下的技术探索与实践，并提出APEC经济体在绿色能源与AI融合方面的合作路径。

Editor's note: The APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will be held in Shenzhen this month. Liang Lingyu, Strategic‑level Expert at China Southern Power Grid and Director of Computing‑Power‑Grid Engineering Company of CSG Digital Research Institute, shares industry insights on the shift toward an AI‑native power grid . He discusses how to align computing workloads with electricity supply and proposes practical APEC cooperation options for green energy and AI integration. Faced with global climate challenges and surging power demand driven by the artificial‑intelligence boom, accelerating green‑energy transition has become an urgent priority to build a power system that is safe, reliable, adequately supplied, {{0}}, {{1}}, sustainable and {{2}}.
paragraphs.cn: 2026年8月27日，在中国西南部贵州省贵阳市举行的2026中国国际大数据产业博览会上，一辆移动算力车在中国南方电网展台吸引参观者。编者按：APEC经济领导人会议将于本月在深圳举行。中国南方电网战略级专家、南网数字研究院算力电网工程公司总监梁凌宇分享了对向AI原生电网转型的行业见解。他讨论了如何将算力工作负载与电力供应相匹配，并提出了APEC在绿色能源与AI融合方面的务实合作选项。面对全球气候挑战和人工智能热潮驱动的电力需求激增，加速绿色能源转型已成为建设安全、可靠、供应充足、有韧性、包容、可持续且可负担的电力系统的紧迫优先事项。

paragraphs.en: Advancing {{3}} development of the six key infrastructure networks – water, electricity, computing, communications, urban underground utilities, and logistics – through new‑grid development serves as a major driving force toward this goal. Better planning alignment matches energy demand with clean‑energy supply across geographies. Joint‑facility construction and resource‑sharing cut {{4}} investment, lower energy consumption and reduce costs. Through unified coordination, flexibly‑scheduled power‑intensive activities such as computing workloads can be prioritized at times and locations with {{5}} green power. This builds a solid green‑energy foundation for more effective climate action, improves the stability, resilience and affordability of energy systems, and better underpins global AI development.
paragraphs.cn: 通过新电网发展推进水、电、算力、通信、城市地下管线和物流六大关键基础设施网络的协调发展，是实现这一目标的主要驱动力。更好的规划协调使能源需求与跨地域的清洁能源供应相匹配。联合设施建设和资源共享可减少重复投资、降低能源消耗并降低成本。通过统一协调，算力工作负载等可灵活调度的电力密集型活动可以在绿色电力充足的时间和地点优先安排。这为更有效的气候行动奠定了坚实的绿色能源基础，提高了能源系统的稳定性、韧性和可负担性，并更好地支撑全球AI发展。

paragraphs.en:
A critical pathway to deliver this vision lies in the AI‑native {{6}}, which merges the precision, real‑time responsiveness and trustworthiness of energy‑sector operations to integrate general‑purpose and domain‑specific models. By deeply {{7}} artificial intelligence into production workflows and organizational models of the power sector, the AI‑native paradigm provides essential energy‑infrastructure backing for industrial‑AI advancement. Meanwhile, by meeting strict requirements for intelligent {{8}}, dependable decision‑making and secure operation in power systems, it identifies generic {{9}} for intelligent transformation of complex industrial systems and offers technological guidance for broader industrial‑AI upgrading. Why the AI‑native paradigm matters
Against shared pressures from global climate change and the AI revolution, energy constitutes a key battlefield and power systems act as a primary workhorse. Exploring the AI‑native paradigm and realizing two‑way {{10}} between power infrastructure and power‑sector native AI represents a vital pathway toward energy‑system upgrading, green transition, coordinated infrastructure development and industrial‑AI transformation.
paragraphs.cn: 实现这一愿景的关键路径在于AI原生范式，它融合了能源行业运营的精确性、实时响应性和可信性，以整合通用模型和领域特定模型。通过将人工智能深度嵌入电力行业的生产工作流程和组织模式，AI原生范式为工业AI发展提供了必要的能源基础设施支撑。同时，通过满足电力系统在智能感知、可靠决策和安全运行方面的严格要求，它识别出复杂工业系统智能化转型的通用方法论，并为更广泛的工业AI升级提供技术指导。为什么AI原生范式重要

paragraphs.en: Power systems possess unique strengths in terms of public‑service mandate, strategic importance and system complexity. Delivering technical breakthroughs of the AI‑native energy architecture within industrial scenarios can realize dual dividends: robust energy‑infrastructure support and innovation‑driven leadership, which in turn accelerate overall industrial‑AI progress and digital‑intelligent upgrading across real‑economy industries. First, as foundational infrastructure linking energy production, industrial operations, urban governance and social livelihoods, advances in the AI‑native paradigm will upgrade energy systems and deliver more stable, reliable and affordable power supplies to underpin large‑scale deployment of industrial‑AI applications. Furthermore, power systems serve as a representative test‑bed for exploring industry‑native AI. Power supply requires real‑time supply‑demand balance; generation, transmission and consumption are tightly {{11}}, and all operations must satisfy {{12}} safety rules.
paragraphs.cn: 面对全球气候变化和AI革命的共同压力，能源是关键战场，电力系统是主要工作载体。探索AI原生范式，实现电力基础设施与电力行业原生AI的双向赋能，是通往能源系统升级、绿色转型、基础设施协调发展和工业AI转型的重要路径。

paragraphs.en:
As growing volumes of {{13}}‑renewable‑energy generation from wind and solar feed into grids, closer coordination is needed among power‑generation, end‑use and energy‑storage assets, raising operational and coordination complexity. AI must interpret physical laws governing power‑system behavior, detect evolving conditions and make robust decisions under complex {{14}} to guarantee operational safety. These challenges are widely shared across other industrial sectors. For this reason, technical advances and practical experience from the AI‑native paradigm can deliver valuable reference for other industries and catalyses broader industrial‑AI development. China's practice
Confronted with global climate change and heavy power loads brought by artificial‑intelligence expansion, China is advancing new‑grid development to boost coordination across the six key infrastructure networks, advance green‑energy transition and build a stable, clean, sufficient and affordable energy foundation for AI growth.
paragraphs.cn: 电力系统在公共服务使命、战略重要性和系统复杂性方面具有独特优势。在工业场景中实现AI原生能源架构的技术突破可以带来双重红利：强大的能源基础设施支撑和创新驱动的引领作用，进而加速整体工业AI进步和实体经济行业的数字智能升级。首先，作为连接能源生产、工业运营、城市治理和社会民生的基础基础设施，AI原生范式的进步将升级能源系统，提供更稳定、可靠和可负担的电力供应，以支撑工业AI应用的大规模部署。此外，电力系统是探索行业原生AI的代表性试验平台。电力供应需要实时供需平衡；发电、输电和用电紧密相连，所有运营都必须满足严格的安全规则。

paragraphs.en: The AI‑native paradigm provides core technical support for this undertaking. To satisfy requirements for coordinated national critical‑infrastructure development featuring "unified dispatching, tiered management and on‑site decision‑making", China has proposed and is implementing an integrated technical framework built on four pillars: AI‑native interaction, AI‑native architecture, AI‑native processes, and AI‑native tool integration. AI‑native interaction: allows operators to submit requirements and complete tasks using everyday‑language inputs, lowering technical barriers for cross‑network business workflows. AI‑native architecture: reorganizes industry‑wide digital underpinnings around AI, enabling {{15}} among diverse agents, algorithms and models and advancing connectivity across intelligent systems of the six key infrastructure networks. AI‑native processes: empowers intelligent agents serving the six key infrastructure networks to {{16}} generate solutions and collaborate on tasks, supporting integrated planning and sequenced construction of cross‑network infrastructure.
paragraphs.cn: 随着风能和太阳能等可变可再生能源发电量不断增长并接入电网，发电、终端用电和储能资产之间需要更紧密的协调，这提高了运营和协调的复杂性。AI必须解读支配电力系统行为的物理规律，检测不断变化的条件，并在复杂约束下做出稳健决策，以保证运营安全。这些挑战在其他工业部门中普遍存在。因此，AI原生范式的技术进步和实践经验可以为其他行业提供宝贵参考，并催化更广泛的工业AI发展。中国的实践

paragraphs.en: AI‑native tool integration: unifies access to diverse professional tools, maps equipment, business workflows and inter‑relationships within the six key infrastructure networks, and enables AI to invoke relevant tools on‑demand for joint task delivery. This technical framework is being put into practice at China Southern Power Grid, enabling coordinated planning, construction, dispatching and operation of related infrastructure. Through its E‑Hong AI innovation platform, China Southern Power Grid interconnects grid equipment, operational systems and artificial‑intelligence capabilities, merging previously siloed data and tool‑sets for seamless workflows – an illustration of AI‑native architecture. For grid‑construction planning, operators can submit work requirements in conversational natural‑language to Da‑Wate, eliminating cumbersome manual operations, embodying AI‑native interaction. Its companion module Da‑Wate Yun‑Rui then analyses where and how much grid capacity should be built, and automatically generates plans and reports.
paragraphs.cn: 面对全球气候变化和人工智能扩张带来的沉重电力负荷，中国正在推进新电网发展，以促进六大关键基础设施网络的协调，推进绿色能源转型，并为AI增长构建稳定、清洁、充足和可负担的能源基础。

paragraphs.en: Tasks that once took multiple days can now be finished within 10 minutes, with AI driving end‑to‑end workflows – demonstrating AI‑native processes. In power dispatching, Tian‑Quan performs high‑speed complex calculations based on generation‑load conditions and grid‑safety constraints. It supports power‑market participants in determining traded energy volumes and prices, furnishing appropriate specialized computing resources for AI‑driven professional tasks, representing AI‑native tool integration. For equipment inspection, artificial‑intelligence models process inspection imagery to identify line hazards and equipment defects, guiding maintenance {{17}}. This shifts equipment upkeep from rigid calendar‑based checks toward condition‑driven maintenance, another real‑world instance of AI‑native processes.
paragraphs.cn: AI原生范式为这一事业提供核心技术支撑。为满足以“统一调度、分级管理、现场决策”为特征的国家关键基础设施协调发展的要求，中国提出并正在实施一个建立在四大支柱之上的综合技术框架：AI原生交互、AI原生架构、AI原生流程和AI原生工具集成。AI原生交互：允许操作员使用日常语言输入提交需求并完成任务，降低跨网络业务工作流程的技术门槛。AI原生架构：围绕AI重组全行业数字基础，实现多样代理、算法和模型之间的互操作性，并推进六大关键基础设施网络智能系统之间的连接。AI原生流程：赋能服务于六大关键基础设施网络的智能代理自主生成解决方案并协作完成任务，支持跨网络基础设施的综合规划和有序建设。

paragraphs.en:
These domestic explorations open new avenues for Asia‑Pacific economies to develop clean energy and build smarter infrastructure. Asia-Pacific green energy integration
China's experience with technical innovation under the AI‑native paradigm and coordinated deployment of the six key infrastructure networks offers fresh cooperative approaches for Asia‑Pacific green‑energy transition and AI‑energy integration. Going forward, APEC economies can deepen multi‑level, cross‑border collaboration across several dimensions:
Joint R&D: Co‑develop AI‑enhanced approaches to boost variable renewable energy utilization for wind and solar power. Explore how to align computing workloads with electricity supply to foster more stable, reliable and greener grid operation. Cross‑border demonstration projects: Launch joint pilots on power‑sector AI and clean‑energy solutions tailored to local energy endowments and practical needs of individual economies.
paragraphs.cn: AI原生工具集成：统一访问多样专业工具，映射六大关键基础设施网络内的设备、业务工作流程和相互关系，并使AI能够按需调用相关工具以联合交付任务。这一技术框架正在中国南方电网付诸实践，实现相关基础设施的协调规划、建设、调度和运营。通过其E-Hong AI创新平台，中国南方电网互联电网设备、运营系统和人工智能能力，合并以前孤立的数据和工具集以实现无缝工作流程——这是AI原生架构的一个例证。对于电网建设规划，操作员可以用对话式自然语言向Da-Wate提交工作要求，消除繁琐的手动操作，体现AI原生交互。其配套模块Da-Wate Yun-Rui然后分析应在何处建设以及建设多少电网容量，并自动生成计划和报告。

paragraphs.en: Test coordinated planning, construction and operation of supporting facilities to accelerate translation of research outputs into real‑world deployment. Standards alignment and knowledge sharing: Encourage participation in international‑standards‑setting. Exchange technical specifications, data‑exchange protocols and usage rules to improve interoperability of equipment and systems across borders, and enable coordinated dispatching of emergency‑response resources. Infrastructure and industrial cooperation: Promote resource‑sharing and coordinated operation across water‑supply, power, computing, communications, urban‑underground‑utility and logistics infrastructure. Examples include scheduling computing workloads in response to power‑generation profiles, and integrated laying of pipelines and cables during urban‑renovation programmes.
paragraphs.cn: 曾经需要多天完成的任务现在可以在10分钟内完成，AI驱动端到端工作流程——展示AI原生流程。在电力调度中，Tian-Quan根据发电负荷条件和电网安全约束执行高速复杂计算。它支持电力市场参与者确定交易电量和价格，为AI驱动的专业任务提供适当的专业计算资源，代表AI原生工具集成。对于设备检查，人工智能模型处理检查图像以识别线路隐患和设备缺陷，指导维护优先级排序。这将设备维护从僵化的基于日历的检查转向基于状态的维护，这是AI原生流程的另一个现实实例。

paragraphs.en: Expand cross‑regional and cross‑enterprise collaboration to reduce redundant construction and resource waste, improve variable‑renewable‑energy utilization, and cut energy use and carbon emissions during construction and operation. Looking ahead, through co‑innovation on technologies, co‑building of use‑case scenarios, harmonized standards and win‑win ecosystem development, APEC economies can accelerate delivery of a green, smart, reliable and inclusive modern energy and infrastructure system.

电力系统在公共服务使命、战略重要性和系统复杂性方面具有独特优势。在工业场景中实现AI原生能源架构的技术突破可以带来双重红利：强大的能源基础设施支撑和创新驱动的引领作用，进而加速整体工业AI进步和实体经济行业的数字智能升级。首先，作为连接能源生产、工业运营、城市治理和社会民生的基础基础设施，AI原生范式的进步将升级能源系统，提供更稳定、可靠和可负担的电力供应，以支撑工业AI应用的大规模部署。此外，电力系统是探索行业原生AI的代表性试验平台。电力供应需要实时供需平衡；发电、输电和用电紧密相连，所有运营都必须满足严格的安全规则。

随着风能和太阳能等可变可再生能源发电量不断增长并接入电网，发电、终端用电和储能资产之间需要更紧密的协调，这提高了运营和协调的复杂性。AI必须解读支配电力系统行为的物理规律，检测不断变化的条件，并在复杂约束下做出稳健决策，以保证运营安全。这些挑战在其他工业部门中普遍存在。因此，AI原生范式的技术进步和实践经验可以为其他行业提供宝贵参考，并催化更广泛的工业AI发展。中国的实践

面对全球气候变化和人工智能扩张带来的沉重电力负荷，中国正在推进新电网发展，以促进六大关键基础设施网络的协调，推进绿色能源转型，并为AI增长构建稳定、清洁、充足和可负担的能源基础。

AI原生范式为这一事业提供核心技术支撑。为满足以“统一调度、分级管理、现场决策”为特征的国家关键基础设施协调发展的要求，中国提出并正在实施一个建立在四大支柱之上的综合技术框架：AI原生交互、AI原生架构、AI原生流程和AI原生工具集成。AI原生交互：允许操作员使用日常语言输入提交需求并完成任务，降低跨网络业务工作流程的技术门槛。AI原生架构：围绕AI重组全行业数字基础，实现多样代理、算法和模型之间的互操作性，并推进六大关键基础设施网络智能系统之间的连接。AI原生流程：赋能服务于六大关键基础设施网络的智能代理自主生成解决方案并协作完成任务，支持跨网络基础设施的综合规划和有序建设。

AI原生工具集成：统一访问多样专业工具，映射六大关键基础设施网络内的设备、业务工作流程和相互关系，并使AI能够按需调用相关工具以联合交付任务。这一技术框架正在中国南方电网付诸实践，实现相关基础设施的协调规划、建设、调度和运营。通过其E-Hong AI创新平台，中国南方电网互联电网设备、运营系统和人工智能能力，合并以前孤立的数据和工具集以实现无缝工作流程——这是AI原生架构的一个例证。对于电网建设规划，操作员可以用对话式自然语言向Da-Wate提交工作要求，消除繁琐的手动操作，体现AI原生交互。其配套模块Da-Wate Yun-Rui然后分析应在何处建设以及建设多少电网容量，并自动生成计划和报告。

曾经需要多天完成的任务现在可以在10分钟内完成，AI驱动端到端工作流程——展示AI原生流程。在电力调度中，Tian-Quan根据发电负荷条件和电网安全约束执行高速复杂计算。它支持电力市场参与者确定交易电量和价格，为AI驱动的专业任务提供适当的专业计算资源，代表AI原生工具集成。对于设备检查，人工智能模型处理检查图像以识别线路隐患和设备缺陷，指导维护优先级排序。这将设备维护从僵化的基于日历的检查转向基于状态的维护，这是AI原生流程的另一个现实实例。

articles.fullText:
Foreign political party representatives have spoken highly of the Communist Party of China's (CPC) commitment to full and rigorous self-governance, saying its experience in strengthening Party discipline, combating corruption and putting people first offers valuable lessons for socialist parties around the world.
They shared their views with CGTN on the sidelines of the 16th World Socialism Forum, held in Beijing from Tuesday to Wednesday.
Said Bakkali, a member of the Political Bureau of Morocco's Party of Progress and Socialism, said self-governance is essential to maintaining a political party's strength and integrity.
He highlighted the CPC's efforts to combat corruption within the Party, describing corruption as a disease that could "destroy the party from inside."
"So no tolerance, or zero tolerance with corruption, because corruption creates abnormal relationships between party members and outside of party members, and that can weaken the party integrity," he said.
Humphrey Moshi, director of the Centre for Chinese Studies at the University of Dar es Salaam in Tanzania, also commended China's sustained efforts to fight corruption, identifying them as one of the factors behind the country's social and economic progress.
Moshi noted that although a number of African countries, including Tanzania, have laws and provisions aimed at combating corruption, implementation remains a challenge.
"Without fighting corruption, it will be very difficult for Tanzania and other African countries in particular to move forward," he said, adding that African countries had much to learn from China's determination to translate anti-corruption commitments into concrete action.
Beyond fighting corruption, both Bakkali and Moshi highlighted the CPC's close ties with the people as an important aspect of its governance approach.
The leadership of the CPC have been consistent in terms of ensuring that they serve the people and the people come first, said Moshi. And in Bakkali's opinion, it's important that the CPC's self-governance maintains a close connection to the people, including normal citizens, workers and the working class.
Kaivon Kjems, international secretary of the Communist Party of Denmark, said, "People-centric development doesn't happen spontaneously." It needs a strong party that's disciplined, he added.
Taking the example that there are people, who are born within the capitalist system, coming into the Communist Party, Kjems said in those cases, it takes discipline and sincerity to shape people into capable cadres.
The CPC's commitment to self-reform also drew attention from Adam Barbato Shoufani, general secretary of the Swiss Communist Youth.
He said undertaking self-reform requires a party to acknowledge that there are problems to be addressed. "This is a very sign of courage, a very sign of bravery that is missing in a lot of parties in Europe, or was missing in a lot in parties in the history of the international communist movement," he said.
The participants doing interviews with CGTN at the World Socialism Forum in Beijing, China, November 3, 2026. 
The two-day World Socialism Forum, which brought together more than 80 participants from 40 countries, including leaders of foreign communist parties, influential Marxist scholars, social activists and diplomats from foreign missions in China, came at a time when the global left-wing parties seek to play a bigger role in facilitating their countries's development.
Bakkali said the CPC is very important for communist internationalism because it is a vibrant and brilliant example of how a Marxist party can rule a country, especially a vast and populated country like China.
Noting that Morocco's Progress and Socialism Party has an 83-year history, Bakkali said the party has always maintained a very great relationship and cooperation with the CPC.
Bakkali added that Morocco's Progress and Socialism Party is learning a lot from the CPC's self-governance and efforts in terms of searching peaceful resolutions to conflicts.
"I think that the CPC is bringing innovative solutions and ideas to strengthen not only the communist socialist internationalism, but also to bring new ideas to international community, to international organizations, to find peaceful and lasting resolutions to different conflicts around the world," Bakkali said.
Echoing Bakkali, Moshi said how China, under the leadership of CPC, cooperates with other countries is impressive. Taking the example of Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence, which centering on the principle of sovereign equality, Moshi said China doesn't interfere with the internal affairs and respects the sovereignty of other countries, all those earn a lot of respect for the CPC and worth learning for African political parties.
Kjems and Shoufani, as representatives from European left-wing parties, both agreed there are a lot to learn from the CPC.
"The lessons are numerous, and it's hard to pinpoint just one. But the fact that it's not just talk, it's action that the CPC pushes," said Kjems. Taking China's Five-year plans as an example, Kjems said China actually carried out those plans, emphasizing that putting words into practice is what truly matters.
Shoufani noted that in Europe, the political class does not answer to the people anymore, but "it answers to the interests of profit," whereas the CPC stays dedicated to serving the people.

莫希指出，尽管包括坦桑尼亚在内的许多非洲国家都有旨在打击腐败的法律和条款，但执行仍是一个挑战。他说：“如果不打击腐败，坦桑尼亚和其他非洲国家将很难向前迈进。”他补充说，非洲国家可以从中国将反腐承诺转化为具体行动的决心中学到很多。除了打击腐败，巴卡利和莫希都强调中共与人民的密切联系是其治理方式的一个重要方面。莫希说，中共领导层在确保服务人民和人民至上方面始终如一。在巴卡利看来，中共的自我治理与人民保持密切联系很重要，包括普通公民、工人和工人阶级。

丹麦共产党国际书记凯文·凯姆斯表示：“以人民为中心的发展不会自发发生。”他补充说，这需要一个纪律严明的强大政党。凯姆斯以在资本主义制度下出生的人加入共产党为例说，在这些情况下，需要纪律和真诚才能将人塑造成有能力的干部。中共对自我改革的承诺也引起了瑞士共产主义青年团总书记亚当·巴尔巴托·舒法尼的关注。他说，进行自我改革要求政党承认有问题需要解决。“这是一种非常勇敢的标志，一种在欧洲许多政党中缺失、或在国际共产主义运动历史上许多政党中缺失的勇气。”

2026年11月3日，与会者在中国北京的世界社会主义论坛上接受中国国际电视台采访。为期两天的世界社会主义论坛汇集了来自40个国家的80多名参与者，包括外国共产党领导人、有影响力的马克思主义学者、社会活动人士和驻华外交使团外交官。此时正值全球左翼政党寻求在促进本国发展方面发挥更大作用之际。巴卡利说，中共对共产主义国际主义非常重要，因为它是一个充满活力和光辉的榜样，展示了一个马克思主义政党如何治理国家，尤其是像中国这样幅员辽阔、人口众多的国家。巴卡利指出，摩洛哥进步与社会主义党有83年历史，该党一直与中共保持着非常良好的关系与合作。巴卡利补充说，摩洛哥进步与社会主义党正在从中共的自我治理和寻求和平解决冲突的努力中学到很多。

巴卡利说：“我认为中共带来了创新的解决方案和理念，不仅加强了共产主义社会主义国际主义，也为国际社会、国际组织带来了新理念，以寻求和平持久地解决世界各地的不同冲突。”莫希呼应巴卡利的说法，表示中国在中共领导下与其他国家的合作令人印象深刻。莫希以以主权平等原则为核心的和平共处五项原则为例说，中国不干涉他国内政，尊重他国主权，这些都赢得了对中共的极大尊重，值得非洲政党学习。作为欧洲左翼政党的代表，凯姆斯和舒法尼都同意有很多东西值得向中共学习。“经验很多，很难只指出一点。

但关键是中共推动的不只是空谈，而是行动。”凯姆斯说。凯姆斯以中国的五年规划为例说，中国确实执行了这些规划，强调将言语付诸实践才是真正重要的。舒法尼指出，在欧洲，政治阶层不再对人民负责，而是“对利润利益负责”，而中共则始终致力于服务人民。

The high-tech equipment exhibition zone is prepared ahead of the ninth China International Import Expo, November 3, 2026. 
On the occasion of the ninth China International Import Expo (CIIE), CGTN, in collaboration with Renmin University of China through the New Era International Communication Research Institute, carried out the 2026 Global Survey on World Openness, involving 20,100 respondents across 44 countries worldwide.
The survey indicates that respondents generally view the global openness landscape as becoming increasingly complex and challenging. Cultural exchanges are seen as the easiest form of cross-border engagement, while geopolitical conflicts are identified as the biggest obstacle to global openness. Respondents also spoke positively of China's continued efforts to host the CIIE and advance high-standard opening up, believing that these efforts bring greater certainty to a world marked by turbulence.
In assessing the global openness environment, respondents found cultural exchanges to be the easiest form of cross-border engagement. This view was particularly prevalent among respondents from the Global South, 65.5% of whom reported greater ease in cultural exchanges. Respondents aged 25 to 34 also reported the most positive experiences with global openness. When evaluating factors that facilitate cross-country cooperation, “a growing number of countries participating in trade and cooperation” ranked first.
Meanwhile, 81.4% of respondents identified geopolitical conflicts as the biggest obstacle to global openness, while nearly six in 10 (59.8%) pointed to “unilateral pressure and tariff hikes by major powers” as another major barrier. Looking ahead, respondents from the Global South expressed greater optimism about the prospects for openness. The proportion of people who believe that “the world will become more open in the next one to three years” is nearly twice as high as that among respondents from developed countries.
This year marks the start of China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030). China has rolled out a host of initiatives to actively expand high-standard opening up, earning positive feedback from the international community. When asked which major global economy offers the most valuable experience in opening up and economic development, 42.7% of respondents chose China, the highest share among the economies surveyed. Younger respondents showed even greater recognition of China's experience.
Additionally, nearly 90% of respondents recognized China's economic strength and rapid growth, 84.6% acknowledged China's significant contribution to the global economy, while nearly 80% expressed confidence in the Chinese economy's resilience in the face of risks and challenges.
Among China's various opening-up measures, improvements in market access and visa-free policies made the strongest impression on global respondents. The CIIE also ranked among the top five most recognized measures, serving as a prominent showcase of China's commitment to high-standard opening up.
When asked about their willingness to deepen cooperation with China, 65.6% of respondents expressed interest in further collaboration. Such cooperation extends beyond increased investment and business opportunities to deeper areas, such as research and development and technological collaboration.
Conducted through an online panel survey, the poll was designed to reflect the age and gender distributions reported in the national censuses of the respective countries. It covered major developed economies as well as representative countries of the Global South. The findings have been compiled into the Blue Book of the Global Survey on World Openness.

Global filmmakers are expected to set their sights on China's Hainan Province. The 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival (HIIFF) runs in Sanya from December 6 to 12. Organizers have received 4,632 submissions for this year's Golden Coconut Awards, coming from 133 countries and regions. Bringing together stories and cinematic approaches from across the globe, the festival gives audiences a window into world cinema.
Swedish director Ruben Östlund takes on the role of jury president for the Golden Coconut Awards. /HIIFF
Top international talent stands out among this year's lineup. Swedish director Ruben Ostlund takes on the role of jury president for the Golden Coconut Awards. He is a two-time Palme d’Or winner at Cannes, honored for The Square and Triangle of Sadness. His work carries heavy weight on the international art-film circuit, recognized for sharp observations of modern life and a singular storytelling voice. Thirteen film practitioners from Sweden, Spain, the United States and other places will sit on the jury alongside him. A retrospective of Ostlund's films will run during the festival, letting viewers revisit his landmark works.
Poster for Swedish director Ruben Ostlund's Palme d’Or winner "Triangle of Sadness"
French actress Audrey Tautou serves as the festival's image ambassador. She rose to global fame through her lead performance in Amélie, and her roster of notable works also includes A Very Long Engagement, Coco Before Chanel and The Da Vinci Code.
The Golden Coconut Awards combines competition and public screening sections, spanning feature films, documentaries and shorts. The lineup includes dedicated showcases for titles from Egypt, Greece, Serbia and Thailand, plus an Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) film selection. A Hong Kong cinema strand has also been put together in collaboration with the Hong Kong International Film Festival.
The festival will also bring films to audiences beyond traditional cinema venues. Screenings will take place at cinemas in Sanya, Haikou and other parts of Hainan, alongside four to six outdoor screening locations across the island.
Movie-themed outdoor activities are seen at the 5th Hainan Island International Film Festival. /HIIFF
Screenings will carry on in Sanya and Haikou on weekends after the main festival wraps up. Ticket discounts are available for audiences, and qualifying filmgoers can collect vouchers redeemable at restaurants, grocery stores, gas stations and duty-free shops. Travelers flying into Hainan may also receive movie vouchers bundled with certain flight-related perks.

The 2026 World Internet Conference (WIC) Wuzhen Summit opened on Tuesday in Wuzhen, east China's Zhejiang Province, bringing together governments, international organizations, businesses and academics from around the world.
Under the theme "Open Source and Openness, Collaborative Development and Shared Benefits – Jointly Building a Community with a Shared Future in Cyberspace," this year's summit focuses on open-source AI, with discussions covering technological innovation, security governance, cultural exchanges and international cooperation.
The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit opens in Wuzhen, east China's Zhejiang Province, November 3, 2026. /China Media Group
A highlight of the main forum is the AI Wuzhen Dialogue, which brings together leading global technology companies, executives from open-source large language model companies and AI scientists to explore ways to build a global open-source AI ecosystem. The summit also features 27 sub-forums covering topics such as cyberspace cooperation under the Global Governance Initiative, theories and policies in the digital and intelligent era, and robotics and embodied intelligence.
The summit has also attracted international participation in its case collection and technology awards. The call for outstanding cases of jointly building a community with a shared future in cyberspace received 360 submissions from 80 countries and regions, 22 of which participated for the first time. Eleven cases were shortlisted. Meanwhile, the World Internet Conference Awards for Pioneering Science and Technology received more than 430 submissions from 43 countries and regions. Eighteen countries and regions submitted entries for the first time, while the number of international submissions increased by 21% year on year. A total of 20 projects received awards.
Wang Jian, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, said he believes the WIC will continue to play an important role in China's AI development. As open source and openness are global in nature, he said, the Wuzhen Summit can help China contribute to global AI development.
John Hoffman, CEO of GSMA Ltd., said the Wuzhen Summit provides a platform for sharing information and bringing together ideas on how to build an open internet accessible to all. He said this year's theme also reflects the summit's longstanding commitment to leaving no one behind and creating opportunities for the future of the world.
